categories.main_business_segments: Tianjin Pengling Group Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the automotive parts manufacturing industry, focusing on the design, research and development, production, and sales of automotive fluid pipelines and automotive sealing components. The company has two main business divisions: automotive fluid pipeline products and automotive sealing parts, serving traditional fuel vehicles, hybrid vehicles, pure electric vehicles, and fuel cell vehicles.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages over 30 years of experience in material formulation and manufacturing processes, including rubber, nylon, and TPV materials for fluid pipelines and advanced sealing technologies such as European groove design, frameless technology, and zero-gap technology. It employs modular and systematized production aligned with global automotive standards, uses ERP systems for production planning, and integrates advanced manufacturing equipment including German imported blow molding and injection molding machines to ensure high-quality, flexible, and efficient production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Pengling serves over 50 domestic automotive OEMs including BYD, Changan, FAW-Volkswagen, Great Wall Motors, Geely, SAIC Volkswagen, Chery, and emerging new energy vehicle manufacturers like NIO, XPeng, Li Auto, and Leapmotor. Its products are integrated into passenger cars, commercial vehicles, and new energy vehicles, with a strong presence in both traditional and new energy automotive markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Tianjin, Chengdu, Taizhou (Jiangsu), Xi'an, Hebei, Chongqing, and Shanghai. Its sales cover major Chinese regions including North China, East China, Northeast, Southwest, and Central South, with minimal overseas sales exposure.
categories.supply_chain_position: Pengling operates in the midstream segment of the automotive supply chain as a first-tier supplier to automotive OEMs, providing critical components such as fluid pipelines and sealing parts. It sources raw materials like rubber and nylon from upstream suppliers and delivers integrated component assemblies downstream to vehicle manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in new energy vehicle technologies, focusing on lightweight materials, thermal management systems, modular pipeline assemblies, and advanced sealing solutions. It invests heavily in R&D with dedicated technology centers in Tianjin and Shanghai, pursuing over 300 proprietary formulations and more than 100 patents. Strategic initiatives include expanding heat management modules, adopting ESG principles, and enhancing integration with OEMs through automated production lines and modular product development.
categories.revenue_model: Pengling generates revenue primarily through direct sales of automotive fluid pipeline products and sealing components to OEMs under annual framework contracts. Sales are predominantly on a direct sales basis, with revenue recognized at the point of product delivery and customer acceptance. The company also engages in investment income and government subsidies as supplementary revenue sources.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Pengling is a leading domestic player in automotive fluid pipelines and sealing parts, consistently ranked first in the rubber hose industry by the China Rubber Industry Association. It competes with companies like Junhe Technology, Chuanhuan Technology, and Nanjing Lide Dongfang, maintaining a strong market position through technological innovation, quality, and extensive OEM partnerships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Pengling achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.46 billion, representing a 26.08% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 77.65 million, up 173.36%. Total assets reached RMB 3.59 billion, growing 8.25% from the previous year. The company shows a positive growth trajectory driven by expanding new energy vehicle market demand and enhanced product offerings.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Pengling offers high-quality, technologically advanced automotive fluid pipelines and sealing solutions tailored to both traditional and new energy vehicles. Its competitive advantages include proprietary material formulations, modular integrated product designs, strong R&D capabilities, and close collaboration with leading OEMs. The company emphasizes product reliability, cost-effectiveness, and innovation to meet evolving automotive industry standards and customer needs.
